bias_rules.name: Market Structure Daily Bias
bias_rules.description: Daily bias rules derived from market structure, BOS, CHoCH, and key levels. Moving averages and ATR are secondary supporting tools only.

evidence_hierarchy.3: Significant swing highs and swing lows
evidence_hierarchy.4: Support, resistance, and key price levels

requirements: Recent bullish BOS or strong acceptance above resistance
Price not trapped below major resistance
No confirmed bearish CHoCH against primary structure
Internal structure is bearish or uncertain
Price is near major resistance or extended
Potential bearish CHoCH developing but not confirmed
Bullish and bearish structural evidence balanced
Price between major support and resistance with no edge
Recent BOS or CHoCH attempts have failed
Internal structure is bullish or uncertain
Price is near major support or extended
Potential bullish CHoCH developing but not confirmed
Recent bearish BOS or strong acceptance below support
Price not trapped above major support
No confirmed bullish CHoCH against primary structure

non_negotiable_rules: Market structure is the primary basis of the Daily bias
BOS and CHoCH must be derived from TradingView MCP OHLC data
Do not add a market-structure indicator to TradingView
BOS normally requires a closed Daily candle beyond a meaningful structural swing
A wick-only penetration is not a confirmed BOS
CHoCH is an early structural transition and not automatically a reversal
Distinguish internal CHoCH from primary-structure invalidation
Support and resistance must be based on meaningful Daily reactions
Use zones when exact levels would be misleading
The final bias must reference swings, structural events, support, resistance, and invalidation
Moving averages and ATR remain secondary evidence
Market-structure calculations do not consume TradingView indicator slots
